description: Initiate connecting a new social media account. For OAuth2 platforms (instagram, facebook) returns an auth_url the user must visit to authorize access. After authorization, the account is connected automatically — no follow-up call needed. Present the auth_url link to the user and ask them to let you know once they've completed the authorization. For direct-auth platforms, stores credentials immediately and returns the new account_id.

brand_id.description: Optional brand ID to attach the account to. If omitted, a new brand is auto-created.

name: social_api_connect_account
title: Connect Account
